'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Alex O'Shea DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Alex O'Shea]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Username:''' Thursday
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
